The Chinese characters for Thomas

As a transliteration, Thomas is usually written 托马斯 (Tuō mǎ sī). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

托
Tuō
support, entrust
马
mǎ
horse
斯
sī
this (transliteration)

Origin and meaning

Thomas comes from Aramaic and means “twin”.

About the name Thomas

Saint Thomas was the apostle who doubted until he saw Jesus.

As a gift or a tattoo

Because it means “twin”, a Thomas calligraphy print makes a thoughtful gift for someone who loves the name or its meaning.
